causalAutopsy.notes: The original pre-limit rescue conflated an untagged default-login session with a mutable session binding. The existing set-default credential exchange was present but not composed into ProactiveSwapMonitor.

guardEvidence.howCaught: The registered proactive-swap-monitor controller settles after one default-slot repoint because the default resolver then observes the fresh account below pressure; the existing convergence ratchet also proves its anti-thrash brakes under sustained pressure.
